title: Cloudflare（Workers + D1 + Vue）
description: Runs on Cloudflare: a Worker for the API, D1 (SQLite) for data, and a Vue screen served as static assets from the same Worker. Developed and checked on this computer with wrangler dev, then published with wrangler deploy after approval. A free Cloudflare account is enough to start.

requires.installHint: Node.js 22 or later (https://nodejs.org/). wrangler needs it.
